what_this_is: A capability verdict per artifact, keyed by content hash. It is a SECOND gate, independent of ODYSSEY_LAUNCH_AUTHORIZED. The fence answers 'has a human authorized a run'. This answers 'is this substrate fit to train on at all'. Both must pass.
why_it_exists: The fence was the only gate. Any agent that flipped it to true would have started T0-T7 against an artifact that cannot complete '2 + 2 ='. Integrity sealing (282/282 shards, 59,585 frozen decisions, 0 mismatches) was never evidence of capability, and a six-green-gate receipt sitting in the repo root reads like it was. This file makes that distinction machine-checkable rather than a thing a later reader has to notice.
law: A substrate with verdict REFUSED may not be trained on, whatever the fence says.
Absence of an entry is NOT permission. An unknown artifact is UNVERIFIED and is refused by default.
Only the controller may add or change a verdict, and only with a receipt naming live evidence.
A verdict is bound to a content hash. Repacking the parent produces a different hash and therefore a different, unanswered question.
